project_identity.tagline: The 1990s animated series that predicted your exact digital life.
project_identity.concept: Reads an X handle, discovers the lost episode from 30-season cartoon show 'The Fortunes' that foresaw their life: 1 past roast + 2 future prophecies. Outputs a 16:9 paused TV frame with subtitle bar, metadata, and share triggers.
forbidden_elements: Simpsons names, characters, catchphrases, logos, or copyrighted assets
Full transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim on headers or overlays

typography.font_family_heading: Bebas Neue, Impact, Barlow Condensed, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase font-black
scale.osd_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-yellow-400

key_features_and_flows: Navbar with Logo ('ALREADY AIRED'), Search Handle Quick-Input, Leaderboards link, Recent Ticker link
Landing Hero: Handle Input with (@) prefix, 'Find My Episode' button, Spice Toggle (Roast / Savage)
Recent Episodes Live Ticker: Marquee auto-scrolling recent generated prophecies with episode stills and handles
Analysis Loading State: 'Reading @handle...' with 3 personality tags extracted/editable ('builder', 'chronically online', 'AI obsessed')
3-Tap Fallback Flow: Quick option selector if handle API is throttled or user inputs custom details
Archive Searching Generation State: TV static flicker animation, rolling season/episode numbers, typing text effect, TV channel switch wipe

Episode Output Card (Hero Object): 16:9 paused VHS/TV capture frame, yellow subtitle bar at bottom, episode metadata badge (Season, Ep #, Air Date 1999), 3 prophecy cards (ALREADY HAPPENED, COMING NEXT YEAR, COMING 2029-2032)
Action/Share Bar: One-click Share to X with pre-filled viral text, Copy direct link, Download high-res PNG card preview, 'Prophesy a Friend' CTA
Public Episode View (/ep/:id): Dedicated page for sharing links with big 'Find Your Episode' sticky CTA
Handle Profile Page (/u/:handle): Profile header with avatar, total prophecies, grid of all aired episodes for this user
Leaderboards Page: 3 tabs ('Most Prophesied Handles', 'Top Prophets', 'Most Shared Episodes')
Report Episode Button: Modal dialog to report inaccurate or offensive prophecies
Light/Dark Theme Switcher: CRT Amber Dark Mode vs Vintage Broadcast CRT Light Mode
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="handle-input", data-testid="generate-btn", data-testid="share-x-btn").
Never use generic centered plain white layouts — lean heavily into the dark CRT navy background with electric yellow highlights and scanline texture overlays.
Ensure high contrast on all text: white/yellow readable text over dark semi-opaque surfaces.
Include subtle micro-animations: hover scale, pulse on VHS timestamps, typing animation during generation, scanline shimmer.
